description: Clay is a sales intelligence and enrichment platform built around tables, workflows, and integrations for finding, enriching, and activating company and person data. It also lets teams connect Clay workflows to AI tools through MCP.
summary: Clay exposes an OAuth-protected MCP server at `https://api.clay.com/v3/mcp` and documents a limited Enterprise People & Company HTTP API, but does not publish a traditional public API reference or machine-readable spec for that API.
